$comment: Role-based model routing. Models are provider/model ids resolved by bin/model_call.sh. No vendor is mandatory: any configured provider works. fallback fires on provider failure; strong_finalizer is ONE bounded attempt after proven progress; reasoning-budget ladder is automatic.

strong_finalizer.why: strongest available; bounded; only after meaningful progress

reviewer.why: prefer a different vendor if you have one

providers_note: add a provider in bin/model_call.sh case-block + its key source; see docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md
